# Three Dividend-paying Copper Stocks to Buy as Prices Climb High


By:[Paul Dykewicz](https://www.dividendinvestor.com/author/pdykewicz-admin/)


, September 11, 2026


Link copied!


Three dividend-paying[copper stocks](https://www.dividendinvestor.com/three-multi-metal-stocks-to-consider-buying-for-income-and-growth/) to buy as prices hit a new high, after a multi-day rally fueled by forecasts that President Donald Trump will expand U.S. tariffs.


The price of copper has soared during the past 12 months and investors still can pursue profits, Citi Research wrote in a research note. Copper reached a new record price on Tuesday, Sept. 8, when it touched $14,779 a ton on the London Metal Exchange (LME).


On Wednesday, Sept. 9, copper futures traded in New York at $6.89 per pound to hit its highest level on record. In London trading, copper futures — measured by the metric ton — also reached record highs.


Citi Research expects an “acute global copper supply” constraint to more than offset still-tepid cyclical demand growth, even with Citi Research predicting no U.S. copper cathode import tariff and for the market’s tariff risk to fade in the coming months. The investment firm foresees copper rising to reach $14,500 per metric ton (k/t) by September 2026 and $15,000 per metric ton (k/t) by year-end.


However, structural, cyclical and strategic risks to Citi’s base case skew bullish, reflected in a 30% probability copper will touch $17,000 per metric ton (k/t) in the investment firm’s bull case scenario during the next 12 months. With that backdrop, it is no surprise the share prices of copper mining stocks have been on the ascent lately.


**Three Dividend-paying Copper Stocks to Buy: BHP**


BHP Billiton Ltd. (NYSE: BHP), major multinational mining company headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, has extensive production of a variety of natural resources, including copper, iron ore, coal, oil, natural gas and uranium. Formed in 2001 through the merger of Australian company Broken Hill Proprietary Company (BHP) and the Anglo-Dutch Billiton mining company, BHP Billiton has become one of the world’s largest producers in the natural resources sector.


“Due to its use in AI build-out and electrification of vehicles, copper has replaced iron ore as BHP’s number one produced metal,” said Michelle Connell, founder and chief investment officer with Dallas-based[Portia Capital Management](https://www.portia-capital-management.com/) . “BHP has not only benefited from the increase in demand, but also from copper’s price appreciation of 46% during the past year.”


Accounting for $18.19 billion and 54% for the company’s fiscal year 2026, copper now surpasses iron as BHP’s largest profit contributor, Connell continued. Due to global demand for the metal projected to increase to more than 50 million tons by 2050, BHP plans to increase its output of copper by 40% by 2035. Income investors may appreciate that the company’s dividend yield hovers around 4%.


*Michelle Connell heads[Portia Capital Management](https://www.portia-capital-management.com/) .*


Citi Research rates BHP “neutral on valuation.” The company’s portfolio diversification in favor of copper is likely to help deliver approximately 50% of earnings before interest, taxes and amortization (EBITDA) from copper in FY26, up from roughly 25% during the past five years.


Advertisement.


BHP continues to simplify its core business, and an exit from petroleum should focus the company on existing large-scale assets in copper, iron ore and metallurgical coal with potash an emerging long-life, large-scale asset. Ramp up of BHT’s Jansen potash project in 2027 should further help balance the commodity mix away from historical dominance of iron ore.


*Chart courtesy of[www.stockcharts.com](http://www.stockcharts.com/) .*


**Three Dividend-paying Copper Stocks to Buy: EGO**


Canada’s Eldorado Gold Corp. (NYSE: EGO), of Vancouver, British Columbia, offers an 0.48% dividend yield and a chance for capital appreciation as a recent recommendation of Wall Street-seasoned Jim Woods in his[Bullseye Stock Trader](https://jimwoodsinvesting.stockinvestor.com/offer/bullseye-default/?source=GURUBEST1) advisory service.


*Jim Woods is rated as the No. 1 stock blogger by Tip Ranks.*


Eldorado Gold is a mining firm that owns and operates gold and copper mines in Canada, Greece and Turkey. Woods, who also heads the *[Forecasts & Strategies](https://jimwoodsinvesting.stockinvestor.com/offer/fs-web-default-2/?source=GURUFS)* investment newsletter, advised that EGO’s future stock catalyst will likely be the completion of its large Skouries project in Greece that is intended to allow commercial copper and gold production to increase substantially.


Analysts project roughly 440% output growth for the company while also diversifying its product mix away from gold dependence, said Woods, whose advisory services recommend stocks and related call options. Those services not only include[Bullseye Stock Trader](https://jimwoodsinvesting.stockinvestor.com/offer/bullseye-default/?source=GURUBEST1) , but also[Five Star Trader](https://jimwoodsinvesting.stockinvestor.com/offer/five-star-trader-web-default-2/?source=GURUFST) ,[Tactical Trader](https://jimwoodsinvesting.stockinvestor.com/offer/tactical-trader-web-default-offer/?source=DWDEF1) and[TNT Trader](https://jimwoodsinvesting.stockinvestor.com/offer/tnt-trader-web-default-2/?source=DWDEF1) .


The catalyst of Ivanhoe completing its large Skouries project in Greece has helped EGO shares surge of late, as have the company’s strong bullish metrics, such as its earnings-per-share growth in the top 4% of all companies during the past several quarters and years, Woods wrote. The stock’s relative price strength is in the top 12% over the past 52 weeks, and it is in an industry group benefitting from the current bull sentiment, Woods added.


Technically speaking, EGO is building a new base after its recent share-price highs. The accompanying chart shows the strong move throughout most of August, followed by a pullback and a consolidation, before another advance. The stock climbed 2% by the close of trading on Friday, Sept. 11.


*Chart courtesy of[www.stockcharts.com](http://www.stockcharts.com/) .*


**Three Dividend-paying Copper Stocks to Buy: SCCO**


Dividend-paying Southern Copper Corp. (NYSE: SCCO), of Phoenix, Arizona, has produced a total return of 27.58% since Woods first recommended the stock to subscribers of his *[Forecasts & Strategies](https://jimwoodsinvesting.stockinvestor.com/offer/fs-web-default-2/?source=GURUFS)* investment newsletter on January 5, 2026.


“The metals trade is back on track, and we are right there riding the rails of this win,” Woods wrote to his subscribers in the recently completed September 2026 newsletter. “So, get on board.”


Advertisement.


Key risks, both positive and negative, for Southern Copper include: 1) changes to taxation and regulatory policies; 2) metals price volatility; and 3) currency volatility, wrote Citi Research. The investment firm advised selling the stock in July due to its rising market capitalization.


But Citi Research commented that the impact from aforementioned risks could turn out to be greater or less than estimated. Thus, the shares could fail to reach its target price of $150 or may exceed it.


Income investors may appreciate that SCCO pays a current dividend yield of 2.02%.


*Chart courtesy of[www.stockcharts.com](http://www.stockcharts.com/) .*

Russia broke a three-day pause in attacks on Sept. 8 by firing missiles at Ukraine’s capitol of Kyiv. That aggression followed visits to the capital cities of both countries by President Trump’s envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, who sought to broker a peace agreement.


With military action taking place there, the Middle East and elsewhere, these three investments offer a potentially profitable path to receive share-price appreciation. Investors willing to trade options can try an advisory service that teaches them how to do so.
